action.command:
cd /workspace
git log --oneline -5
echo "---search history for UserMenuContent---"
git log --all --oneline -- "*UserMenuContent*" | head
echo "---find in repo---"
find / -name "UserMenuContent.vue" 2>/dev/null
find / -name "UserInfo.vue" 2>/dev/null

git ls-tree -r HEAD --name-only | grep -i "resources/js/components" | grep -i user
